cues.text: The boy in striped pyjamas takes the signed contract, reads it and hugs it to his chest, then holds it up beside his head.
The boy stretches one arm out toward you, then breaks apart into black flecks and is gone. You stand alone by the front desk.
Yukari, a girl about your age, stands at the foot of the stairs, frowning at you, braced as if for a fight. A gun hangs in a holster on her thigh.
Yukari edges toward you, her hand creeping down to the gun at her thigh.
Behind Yukari, Mitsuru, a young woman with long hair, stands in the hallway with one hand on her hip. Yukari draws the gun from her thigh and holds it down at her side.
